case_detail.name: hybrid-ssm idle check passes with reservation
full check sources reserved from allocator

fix: allocator-owned lifetime tokens join the idle conservation invariant: available + evictable + protected + session_held + uncached + reserved == total
limits: Real KVarNPageAllocator free-list/reservation/clear/lifetime-free logic and the real SchedulerInvariantChecker (hybrid-SSM idle path, busy path, stock paged allocator, pre-fix negative control) ran on CPU inside the pinned stage-13 runtime image; no tensors/GPU serving, no model loading, no numerics tested.
defect: the 0.98 stage-13 admission window built the full 263168-token pool, initialized all backends, entered the scheduler event loop, and was killed at the first idle tick by a false pool leak: [full] total=263168, available=263040 with evictable=protected=session_held=uncached=0; the 128-token gap is the KVarN graph-dummy page reserved by design for the runner lifetime
convention: mirrors the existing scheduler-facing capacity hooks on BaseTokenToKVPoolAllocator (evict_to_free_tokens, check_decode_capacity, verify_byte_accounting): a default-zero method that only KVarNPageAllocator overrides
series: experimental.series entry 14; full fourteen-patch series applies to upstream 0bcd822377da7b5718e674eaf9c870d349424dd1 inside the image build
